nag_style.label: Ticket style
nag_style.description: How FILE A TICKET plays on the front. OK on the back changes it while the app runs.

redirect_style.label: Redirect style
redirect_style.description: How ALEX and SAM play on the front. OK on the back changes it while the app runs.

clock_style.label: Clock
clock_style.description: The front clock, with or without the sprint.

title_cards.label: Title cards
title_cards.description: With the Majora's Mask clock: 'Dawn of the Nth Day' each work day, and when the app starts. Hold START to see it.

sprint_changes.label: Sprint changes
sprint_changes.description: Exceptions to the two-week sprints, separated by commas. 26=2026-12-17 moves sprint 26's start (the one before runs until then); add /3w to make it 3 weeks; 26/3w only changes its length; 30+/3w makes sprint 30 and every later one 3 weeks; off=2026-12-24..2027-01-01 marks days off. Everything else is worked out.

show_date.label: Show date
show_date.description: The calendar, and the date line on the plain and sprint bar clocks.
